messages:
Maya (AE): quick heads-up — QuantumHealth wants to kick off a 45-day POC but procurement paused signing. Two blockers: vendor-signed HSM attestation in the DPA and they want quarterly invoicing for a 6-month reserved commit.
Ben (Legal): can you drop their uploaded orderform and DPA link? I need to check audit/indemnity and the subprocessors paragraph.
Maya (AE): portal link: https://portal.redwood.ai/uploads/QH-PO-2026-900.pdf — short order summary pasted below:

```
PO: QH-PO-2026-900
Amount: $60,000 (6-month reserved commit)
Instance: dedicated-8xA100
Billing: requested quarterly invoicing; start-of-term billing preferred
Security: vendor-signed HSM attestation requested; DPA redline attached by customer
Signature: DocuSign to procurement@quantumhealth.gov + legal@quantumhealth.gov
```

Zoe (Solutions): if Dedicated is confirmed we can support BYO-KMS and provide HSM-backed keys. That will make attestation easier. If they want Hosted, attestation language is more limited.
Pri (Security): we have a standard HSM attestation template the infra team signs. For vendor-signed attestation we need Legal to add a one-page attestation appendix. I can attach SOC2 AICPA excerpt and KMS diagram.
Omar (Finance): quarterly invoicing for a 6-month commit means two invoices. That's acceptable but we need explicit payment terms (net-30) and a risk cap for the POC conversion window. Also need to know if billing is invoice-at-term-start or usage-start.
Ben (Legal): action plan: 1) I'll redline the DPA to narrow subprocessor permissions and add an HSM attestation addendum draft. 2) propose countersign window of 4 business days.
Maya (AE): customer prefers DocuSign and asked for countersign in 5 business days on their side. I'll confirm signer names/emails.
redwood-bot: infra-note: dedicated-8xA100 us-west-2 pool spare capacity: 10%.
Zoe (Solutions): i'll create a one-page "POC orderform/BOM" showing reserved vs burst hours, monitoring credits, and a short SLA excerpt (p95 latency, uptime target, fallback plan). That typically eases procurement reviews.
Pri (Security): I'll upload the attestation template to the portal once Ben confirms appendix language.
Omar (Finance): once PO pdf and final invoice cadence are confirmed I'll approve quarterly flow and create vendor billing instructions.
Ben (Legal): will drop DPA redline + HSM appendix into the portal by EOD and tag this thread. Please @me if procurement pushes for broader indemnities.
Maya (AE): thanks — I'll confirm Dedicated vs Hosted and signer emails, then loop procurement. Please ping me when drafts are live. :thumbsup:
